source: Dense ZXNAME0000XZ avoids making the complete score and probability matrices into ZXNAME0001XZ-resident intermediates. A score tile is generated, merged into the row-wise normalization and output state while it is still on chip, and then discarded. The dense softmax-attention function being evaluated is unchanged.[13]
zh: 密集 ZXNAME0000XZ 避免将完整的分数和概率矩阵放入 ZXNAME0001XZ 驻留中间体中。生成分数图块，在其仍在芯片上时将其合并到行归一化和输出状态中，然后将其丢弃。 The dense softmax-attention function being evaluated is unchanged.[13]
